title: Host-based authentication allows every address in postgres — review required
description: A pg_hba.conf entry with 0.0.0.0/0 accepts connections from any address, not just the application subnet. Combined with password authentication, that exposes the database to credential stuffing from the whole internet. The rule flags the entry; whether a firewall restricts reachability is a review decision.
remediation: Restrict host entries to the exact application and administrator subnets, and require scram-sha-256 or certificate authentication.
limitation: Lexical: matches one pg_hba line; actual reachability depends on network controls that the file cannot show.

tests.line: # audit: host    all             all             0.0.0.0/0               scram-sha-256 present
